buildCommand: npm run data && npm run og && npm run build

api/og.ts._comment: Every module this function reaches that lives outside /api, listed: the bundler does not trace relative specifiers that carry a .ts extension. Adding an import to scripts/card.ts without adding it here returns FUNCTION_INVOCATION_FAILED at runtime and nowhere earlier — the build stays green. card.ts drew its curve with src/lib/chart.ts and now draws the real mark, so chart.ts is out and draw/ink/letters are in.
